name: Poof
description: Install poof and optionally install pre-built binaries from GitHub Releases. poof and any installed tools are added to PATH for subsequent steps.
author: pirafrank

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: poof version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Version of poof to bootstrap (e.g. `v0.6.0`). Defaults to `latest`, which always installs the most recent release.

inputs.name: packages
inputs.label: Packages to install
inputs.helpMarkDown: Newline or comma-separated list of GitHub repos to install, in `USER/REPO` format with an optional tag after `@` (e.g. `ms-jpq/sad` or `pirafrank/vault-conductor@v0.3.0`). Leave empty to skip package installation.

inputs.name: githubToken
inputs.label: GitHub token
inputs.helpMarkDown: GitHub personal access token for authenticated API requests. Pass a pipeline secret variable using macro syntax (e.g. `$(MY_GITHUB_PAT)`). Avoids GitHub API rate limiting (60 req/h unauthenticated → 5,000 req/h authenticated). Leave empty to use unauthenticated requests.
